|lore=Pilots are often reassigned at the last minute for a variety of tactical reasons. Darth Vader ordered DS-61-2 and DS-61-3 to accompany him to the Battle of Yavin.

|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Come With Me (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on Vader or your Admiral. Once per deploy phase, may ▼ any Imperial pilot to same location. During any control phase, may place Effect in Used Pile to take any Imperial pilot into hand from table (cards on that character go to owner's Used Pile).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on Vader or your admiral. During your deploy phase, may deploy an Imperial pilot here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During any control phase, may place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Imperial pilot on table into hand (place all cards on that character in owner’s Used Pile).” '''What changed:''' “Admiral. Once per” → “admiral. During your”; “▼ any” → “deploy an”; “to same location.” → “here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; added “this”; “any” → “an”; added “on table”; “from table (cards” → “(place all cards”; “go to owner's” → “in owner’s”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 29. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Come With Me]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Come With Me (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Come With Me]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_29.
